parts: I would like to implement a UI using HTML5 and supporting JS libraries (Bootstrap 3, Jquery). In my server.R code I have data management functions using Sqlite. I need to make the DF resulting from reading the database accessible in the HTML forms. The resulting changes need to be then returned to the server. I am reviewing an article in http://www.r-bloggers.com/sending-data-from-client-to-server-and-back-using-shiny/ but I am having difficulty understanding how that approach would fit my requirements. Any other guidance or example would be a great help. Thank You
